title: Oro Application Update Manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json files used by the Oro Application Update Protocol.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Gates breaking changes in the manifest layout.

appId.description: Application identifier (typically a reverse-DNS string, aligned with meta_bundle_identifier in oro.toml).

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) indicating when the manifest was generated.

channels.description: List of channel identifiers (for example, stable, beta).

version.description: Application version for this update (aligned with meta_version in oro.toml).

channel.description: Channel name this update belongs to (for example, stable, beta).

minRuntimeVersion.description: Minimum Oro runtime version required to apply this update.

critical.description: Marks this update as critical (for example, security fixes).

notesUrl.description: URL pointing to human-readable release notes for this update.

targets.description: Per-platform targets for this update. May be empty for source-only flows.

platform.description: Target platform identifier (for example, darwin, win32, linux).

arch.description: Target CPU architecture (for example, x64, arm64).

osVersionRange.description: Optional OS version range for this target (for example, '>=11').

artifactUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL where the update artifact can be fetched.

length.description: Length of the artifact in bytes.

artifactSignature.description: Optional detached signature for the artifact payload.
